name: sap-mx-cfdi
description: Comprehensive reference for Mexico's CFDI 4.0 electronic invoicing standard and its complements (Pagos, Nómina, Carta Porte, Comercio Exterior, Global) and how SAP S/4HANA implements them. Use when filling out, validating, or troubleshooting a CFDI document or any of its complements, when distinguishing SAP's eDocument Cockpit from Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC), or when checking which SAT catalog/version is currently mandatory.
